title: Flaky integration tests in CI due to shared test database state
description: CI intermittently fails with unique-constraint errors on the users table. Tests appear to be leaking state between runs when executed in parallel.

comments.author: lin
comments.text: Root cause: a handful of tests used hardcoded emails/usernames instead of factory-generated unique values, so they collided when pytest-xdist ran them in different worker processes against the same test database template.

implementation_notes: Replaced hardcoded fixture values with factory_boy sequences to guarantee uniqueness per test, and confirmed each pytest-xdist worker gets its own Django test database (--create-db was masking this before). Added a CI lint rule flagging hardcoded email/username literals in test files going forward.
resolution: Flaky failures stopped after the fix; CI has been stable for two weeks since.
